profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit investor founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Its website describes the firm as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence. The site also references a broad, category-defining finance workflow platform built on proprietary data and world-class AI talent.

The company's site includes statements on AI and talent, including the view that talent is a bigger factor in the AI race against China than the next three or four factors combined, including chips, and that people with curiosity and agency who fully use AI will gain expertise faster than others. It also discusses lithium discoveries in India and the potential collapse of elite universities' business model.

Court records show 281 legal matters involving Khosla Ventures in California.
